title: Claude Code + Blink: Build the Full Stack, Not Just the Frontend
summary: Claude Code writes the app. Blink Cloud provides the database, auth, and deploy. Learn how to connect them in 2 commands and ship production apps without wiring infrastructure.
body_markdown: Tools handle specific operations — create a database table, set an environment variable, trigger a deploy. Skills are higher-level sequences Claude uses for multi-step tasks like provisioning a full auth system or running a database migration. The 80+ tools give Claude Code precise control over each operation; the 14 skills give it the judgment to execute them in the right order.
